_note: Faction / special-monster token FRAMES (ornate rings). Rendered like portraits via gen_portraits.py, then tokenize.py masks each to a circular annulus and bakes it over a portrait. 'slug' is the frame name. Center content is irrelevant - the annulus mask keeps only the outer band.
_chroma_note: Frames render on a SOLID MAGENTA field (background AND center) so tokenize.py prep can chroma-key it away, leaving only the ornate ring with real transparency. Only the ring band should be non-magenta.
